description: What it costs to bring imports in, month by month: the general import value, the freight and insurance charges, the CIF value, the charges as a share of the value and the CIF value as a share of the general value. Imports only. Only reporters that publish charges have it (see get_catalog, "measures"); other reporters get the error measure_unavailable. A ratio without a usable denominator or figure is null, never 0. Use it for freight, insurance and CIF against the import value.

code.description: Required. HS or national code; dots are ignored.

country.description: Optional partner country (ISO alpha-2 code or name); omit for the world total.

reporter.description: Required. The reporting country whose customs statistics are read: "JP" (Japan), "US" (United States), "GB" (United Kingdom) or "EU" (European Union (27 member states)). Partners are the other countries.

to.description: Optional last month, YYYY-MM (or YYYY). Default: the latest published month.

name: get_landed_cost
